U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

 Washington, D.C. 20530 

July 3, 2018 

The Solicitor General   

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Culbertson v. Berryhill, 
No. 17-773                         

Dear Mr. Harris: 

On  May  21,  2018,  the  Court  granted  the  petition  for  a  writ  of  certiorari  in  the  above-
captioned  case.    Petitioner’s  brief  and  the  government’s  brief  as  respondent  on  the  merits  are 
currently due on July 5, 2018. 

Because  of  scheduling  difficulties  and  the  press  of  other  matters  before  the  Court,  the 
parties respectfully request, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, an 11-day extension of 
time, to and including July 16, 2018, within which to file the petitioner’s and government’s briefs; 
and  a  23-day  extension  of  time,  to  and  including  September  7,  2018,  within  which  to  file  the 
appointed amicus curiae’s brief.    If those extensions are granted, the reply brief would be due on 
October 9, 2018 (a Tuesday after a holiday). 

The parties have agreed on the schedule above, which is necessary to accommodate to the 

litigation schedules of counsel. 

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
